name: Select
description: A custom single-select built on the select-only combobox pattern: the listbox scales and fades out of the trigger, flips above it when there is no room, and draws a check next to the selected option. Supports typeahead, full keyboard navigation and disabled options.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox pattern: the trigger is role="combobox" with aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; the popup is role="listbox" with role="option" items carrying aria-selected/aria-disabled. Focus never leaves the trigger. Arrow keys, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown move the active option, Enter/Space select, Alt+ArrowUp selects and closes, Escape closes, Tab selects and moves on, and printable characters typeahead to matching options. Outside clicks close the listbox. The visible label is associated via aria-labelledby. Under prefers-reduced-motion the popup only fades.
